items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: I was staying with a tenor player by the name of Lem Johnson. He and I lived together after I was separated from my first wife.

ctx.x: Now, who was in the Skeets Talbot band?

Carl 'Taddy' Smith, who had been with Basie. The rest of the guys you wouldn't know, Lem Johnson was the tenor player. Freddy Jefferson was the piano player and Charles Bloomer was the drummer, who-he and I joined Benny Goodman on the Camel Caravan show in '39. Skeets Talbot was the alto and the arranger. He's a professor in Texas. That was it.
But every night, John would bring a different group of people down and they would sit in.
